description: Details for one paper, including the abstract and a free to read link when one exists. A wrong or unknown reference returns a not found error that suggests searching by title or checking the DOI format. Inputs: paper (optional, a DOI like 10.1038/nature14539, a doi.org link, or an OpenAlex id like W2741809807), doi (optional, a DOI like 10.1038/nature14539 or a doi.org link, no OpenAlex ids). Give paper or doi, and paper wins if you give both. Example prompt: 'show me the abstract of DOI 10.1038/nature14539.'

doi.description: A DOI like 10.1038/nature14539, or a doi.org link. No OpenAlex ids here. Give this or paper.

paper.description: A DOI like 10.1038/nature14539, a doi.org link, or an OpenAlex id like W2741809807. Give this or doi.

name: get_paper
title: Get a paper
